messages:
lina_partnerships: Heads-up — Fractal (HW partner) marketplace flow is blocked. PO won't accept because vendor tax ID mismatch and legal redlined our indemnity clause. Customer (EdgePulse) wants Dedicated onboarding tomorrow. Can we triage?

chris_sales: Ugh. Do we have the exact portal error? Is this vendor-side or our validation? :eyes:

lina_partnerships: Vendor portal screenshot pasted in thread (see below). Error reads: "Vendor tax ID failed verification: ID format mismatch (country=US)." And legal flagged our standard mutual indemnity -> they want unilateral indemnity.

meera_legal: I saw the redline — Fractal replaced mutual indemnity with a full vendor-first indemnity plus unlimited liability carveouts. Not acceptable. We can propose a capped indemnity tied to contract value + carveouts for gross negligence.

jordan_ops: For kickoff timing, can we provision a temporary staging seat not tied to the marketplace PO? Then swap once PO clears? Ops can do a one-off internal charge, but requires finance sign-off.

chris_sales: If staging helps, do it — but we need procurement to accept internal PO + vendor onboarding. Also need to avoid double-billing. Sasha, can finance fast-track reconciliation? @sasha_finance

sasha_finance: I can help but need the vendor legal entity + W-9/EIN copy. If tax ID truly mismatches, we need corrected vendor docs before payment. Send me the vendor contact.

lina_partnerships: Vendor contact: legal@fractal-hw.com, EIN on their portal appears as "12-3456789" but portal validator expects 12-345-6789 (format mismatch). Screenshot attached. Likely a frontend parser issue?

devops-bot: Ticket created: DEALDESK-1234 — Fractal marketplace PO blocked (tax id + legal redline). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEALDESK-1234

meera_legal: For indemnity -- quick negotiation option: (1) propose mutual indemnity, (2) include a $250k cap for third-party IP/indemnities for the initial 12 months, (3) explicit carveout for willful misconduct and gross negligence. That should be acceptable to most HW vendors.

chris_sales: I can propose that to Fractal rep. Lina — can you share the draft contract they sent and the marketplace standard? I'll ping them.

lina_partnerships: Uploaded contract v3.pdf to the ticket. Also added the marketplace acceptance logs.

jordan_ops: FYI, provisioning via internal PO will require tagging the capacity as "pre-prod" and adding an activation guard so we don't accidentally bill production. Ops will need a signed SOW or PO reference.

sasha_finance: If vendor can resend W-9 with hyphenated format, we can proceed with internal PO route and clear reimbursements later. Without corrected tax doc, AP cannot process.

meera_legal: One more legal note — if we accept a vendor-first indemnity now just to unblock, insist on a short-term exception (30 days) and auto-revert to mutual indemnity on final contract. Document the exception in the ticket and get an exec-approved signoff.

chris_sales: Reached out to Fractal rep via email + CC'd legal. Proposed the mutual + $250k cap + 30-day exception if they need immediate kickoff. Waiting for reply.

lina_partnerships: Fractal responded: they'll send corrected W-9 and said their legal can accept mutual indemnity if Redwood adds a "supply chain" carveout. They're asking for specific language.

meera_legal: Supply chain carveouts are OK if narrowly defined. I'll draft 3-line clause and paste here.

meera_legal: Draft clause: "Neither party shall be liable for indirect loss arising from third-party supply chain disruptions, provided the affected party uses commercially reasonable efforts to mitigate." Thoughts?

chris_sales: LGTM. Send to them and ask for the corrected W-9.

lina_partnerships: Sent draft & request for W-9. Fractal says the W-9 will be sent within 2 hours.

devops-bot: DEALDESK-1234 updated: vendor W-9 received (pending validation).

sasha_finance: Once W-9 validated, I can approve internal PO reconciliation. Please attach the gov-validated W-9 to the invoice for audit trail.

jordan_ops: If all goes well, we can do staging provisioning in ~90 minutes after finance OK. Ops will stand by.

chris_sales: Fractal legal accepted the mutual indemnity + $250k cap + supply chain clause. They also confirmed corrected EIN format.

lina_partnerships: Great — moving to finalize. Will mark DEALDESK-1234 as in-progress and attach final contract. Thanks everyone. :tada:

sasha_finance: I'll do the reconciliation and close finance tasks after we get invoices.

meera_legal: Please keep the 30-day exception language on the ticket in case of follow-up.

lina_partnerships: Noted. Closing loop here — provisioning scheduled for 13:30 PT. Will post a short recap after onboarding.
